Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL1122107. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and return all columns.
